title: Enchanted Shears
description: Two new enchantments, Shearing and Pruning, which increase the drop rates of wool from sheep, as well as leaves and apples from trees.
body:
# Enchanted Shears

![info_b1hpxv](https://res.cloudinary.com/djregmuzg/image/upload/q_auto/f_auto/v1776893031/info_b1hpxv.png)

**Enchanted Shears** is a lightweight yet extremely useful mod that introduces two new enchantments specifically designed for shears. These enhancements make your tools significantly more efficient, allowing for the mass collection of wool, saplings, and apples.

Starting with this mod, shears are now fully unlocked for the **Enchanting Table**.

---

## ✂️ New Enchantments Overview

![pruning_shearing_mbqjwf](https://res.cloudinary.com/djregmuzg/image/upload/q_auto/f_auto/v1776892800/pruning_shearing_mbqjwf.png)

### Enchantment Stats

| Level | Shearing: Additional Wool | Shearing: Total Drop (Average) | Pruning: Sapling Chance | Pruning: Apple Chance (Oak Only) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **I** | +1 item | 2 - 4 pcs. | 25% | 0% |
| **II** | +2 items | 3 - 5 pcs. | 30% | 5% |
| **III** | +4 to 5 items (random) | 5 - 8 pcs. | 50% | 20% |
| **IV*** | +7 items | 8 - 10 pcs. | 50% | 50% |

*\* IV Locked by default (Requires config unlock).*

---

## ⚙️ Configuration (Config)

You can fully customize the mod behavior using these settings:
* **pruningDropsApples**: Enable/disable apple drops from oak leaves.
* **pruningDropsSaplings**: Enable/disable sapling drops from pruned leaves.
* **pruningWorksOnPlayerPlacedLeaves**: Apply effects to leaves placed by the player.
